clauses.title: Every reconciliation outcome is terminal and grants no mutation
clauses.section: ## CL-D45 — Source replies carry deterministic markers and reconcile read-only
requires: Every outcome is terminal for the run; no second POST exists under this decision
a fresh owner-authorized run remains the only continuation
Reconciliation grants no mutation, retry, resume, thread-resolution, approval, or summary authority
